title: Output probability in the amplified run
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine on Boolean inputs, with input $x$, and let $r,T$ be natural numbers. Suppose every choice word of length $T$ makes $N$ halt on $x$. Choose $v\in\{0,1\}$, a natural number $i$, a run index $j\in\{0,\ldots,r\}$ with $j+i=r$, a counter $c\in\{0,\ldots,r+1\}$ with $c\le j$, and an amplified-machine configuration $D$ whose work-tape blocks with index greater than $j$ are blank with their heads at $0$. Let $\mathrm{dec}:\mathbb{N}\to\{0,1\}$. Assume every choice word of length $i(T+|x|+2)+1$ halts the amplified machine from any rewind configuration for run $j$. Also assume that, for every such rewind configuration with counter $c'\le j+1$, the probability that a uniformly random choice word of that length produces output $[v]$ equals the probability that $\mathrm{dec}(c'+s)=v$, where $s$ counts the $T$-bit blocks among $i$ blocks accepted by $N$ on $x$ in a uniformly random $iT$-bit word. Then the probability that a uniformly random choice word of length $T+i(T+|x|+2)+1$, started from the embedding of $N$’s initial configuration at run $j$ and counter $c$, produces output $[v]$ equals the probability that $\mathrm{dec}(c+s')=v$, where $s'$ counts the accepted $T$-bit blocks among $i+1$ blocks in a uniformly random $(i+1)T$-bit word.
hypotheses_covered: Every choice word of length $T$ makes $N$ halt on $x$
Every work-tape block with index greater than $j$ is blank and has its head at $0$ in $D$
Every choice word of length $i(T+|x|+2)+1$ halts the amplified machine from any rewind configuration for run $j$

For each rewind configuration with counter $c'\le j+1$, the stated output probability equals the probability that the decoder applied to the initial counter plus the number of accepted blocks equals $v$
